title: Huliheʻe Palace

buildingCutout.basis: Named native palace footprint and attached service range.

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged local elevation on the palace grounds immediately in front of the lanai approach.

mapIdentity.scope: Named native palace outline, original coastal elevation, National Register measurements, Daughters of Hawaiʻi history and three exact published public-domain Qualla exterior photographs.

note: A stuccoed two-story lava-rubble block with a low green metal gabled roof. A two-deck sea-facing timber lanai has finely spaced balusters, square posts, brackets and a long external stair at the end. Smaller porches mark the street and side entrances.
